_help: Volunteer briefings for the field guide. Each one appears as its own tab from showDaysBefore days ahead until midnight on the event date (Eastern time). Times are 24-hour ("16:15"). Text can use **bold**. startsAt is what the countdown at the top counts down to.

briefings.title: Indy Fuel vs. Cincinnati
briefings.subtitle: We're the **Nonprofit of the Game** at Toy Story & Family Fun Day.

video.title: Our video
video.note: Plays on the big screen during the **2nd intermission**. Watch it ahead of time so you know what fans saw when they stop by our table.

contact.note: Questions or running late? Post in the event group chat on Facebook Messenger.

timeline.label: 2nd intermission
timeline.note: Our video plays, right before the Chuck-a-Puck game that benefits Redemption Rescue (time varies). [[chuck|How Chuck-a-Puck works]]

pass.label: Parking pass
pass.note: Print it and place it on your dashboard. Forgot it? A few printed copies will be available at our table.

sections.title: Arrival & parking
steps: Park in the **staff lot** (there is a sign). The parking pass has a map.
Put your **printed parking pass** on your dashboard.
Enter at the **Honda Gate** on the south/southeast side of the venue.
Head to the **main entrance**. We're at **two tables side by side near the box office**.

sections.title: What you'll be doing
items: Selling **Chuck-a-Puck** foam pucks at our entrance table and around the concourse. **The rescue keeps 60% of every sale!** [[chuck|How Chuck-a-Puck works]]
Offering **animal and fall temporary tattoos** for kids. It's a fun ice breaker before following up with a Chuck-a-Puck ask!
Talking with fans about our **adoptable animals**. The full listing is on the **Animals** tab.
Inviting people to **follow us on Facebook and Instagram**. Scannable QR codes are on the **QR codes** tab.
Collecting **donations** for the rescue. **Cash is welcome**, and our Donate QR code is on the **QR codes** tab.
Staffing our rescue table: answering questions and sharing how to adopt, foster and volunteer.
Helping set up our table and materials before doors open.
The most helpful thing you can bring is a **friendly, outgoing attitude**. Enthusiasm makes a big difference in puck sales!

sections.title: Before you leave home
checklist: Wear your **Redemption Rescue shirt** (any RR shirt works; no shirt? We'll try to get you one)
Comfortable shoes: you'll be on your feet
Clear bag only: leave large or non-clear bags in the car
Card or phone: the venue takes card and mobile payments only

sections.title: Good to know
items: We're **not bringing animals** to this event. The venue doesn't allow animals inside, and with only a few event-ready animals and colder temperatures, we decided to sit this one out.

Our video is expected to play during the **2nd intermission**, right before the Chuck-a-Puck game that benefits Redemption Rescue. We may also have **short videos** during media timeouts and other stoppages in play.

**Claimed a complimentary ticket?** There will be natural lulls during your shift to catch some of the game. Just let a fellow volunteer know before you step away, and keep an eye on the group chat in case we need you.

sections.text: Chuck-a-Puck is a fan game played on the ice during the **2nd intermission**. Fans buy foam pucks, then toss them from the stands at a target on the ice. It's tonight's fundraiser for Redemption Rescue.

sections.title: How it works
steps: Fans buy foam pucks from us at the entrance table and around the concourse before the 2nd intermission.
During the **2nd intermission**, right after our video plays, everyone throws their pucks onto the ice, aiming for the target.
The puck that lands closest to the target wins a prize, announced at the game.

sections.title: Price
sections.text: **$3 per puck** (price not confirmed yet). Encourage fans to grab a few: more pucks, more chances to win.

sections.title: Where the money goes
sections.text: Redemption Rescue keeps **60% of every sale**. Every puck helps rescue dogs and cats in Indiana shelters.

sections.title: Quick pitch
sections.text: “Want to play Chuck-a-Puck? Pucks are $3, you throw them at the 2nd intermission for a prize, and the money helps rescue dogs and cats!”
